# apipbx_phone (Resource)

A desk phone, by MAC address, that provisions itself as an extension from the PBX's /provision/<token>/ address. Import with "<tenant id>/<id>".



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `extension_id` (String)
- `mac` (String) The phone's MAC address, with or without : - separators; stored as 12 lower-case hex digits.
- `model` (String) yealink, grandstream or generic (a JSON file for softphone apps).
- `tenant_id` (String)

### Optional

- `description` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
